card.name: Space before bupivacaine strength percentages
card.fires_on: The space or decimal point right before a percentage strength such as 0.75% or 0.5%, after bupivacaine or Injection in anesthetic dosing text.

modes.label: Space before percentage
modes.description: The blank space after a bupivacaine product name, just before a percent strength.

modes.label: Decimal point in strength
modes.description: The point after 0 in a strength like 0.5% in bupivacaine product tables.
modes.example: Bupivacaine Hydrochloride and Epinephrine Injection 0<<.>>5% (5 mg/mL) is

modes.label: Other linking spot
modes.description: A linking word before a drug name in a conversion or switching dose statement.
modes.example: insulin glargine 300 units/mL<< or>> twice-daily NPH insulin to O

card.writes: It suppresses injection-related words, so the next word is less likely to be 'injection' and more likely to be a number or strength.
card.plain: It fires at the gap just before a bupivacaine strength like 0.5%, where the text expects a number and not the word injection.
